resources.string: Allow SC Kokoro to work in the background so it can keep generating speech when your screen is off. Battery optimization can interrupt reading on some devices. Android will ask you to confirm. Allowing background activity may increase battery use while generating speech.
Background reading is allowed. SC Kokoro is exempt from Android battery optimization.
Battery optimization status is unavailable. You can check the setting to help prevent interruptions when the screen is off.
Open SC Kokoro’s battery settings and allow unrestricted background use or disable battery optimization.
